name: CMOS Inverter
description: Fundamental single-stage CMOS logic gate. PMOS (M_P) pulls output to VDD when input is LOW; NMOS (M_N) pulls output to GND when input is HIGH. Zero static power. The building block of all CMOS digital logic.

High Speed.reasoning: Wide PMOS (2x NMOS) at minimum length; symmetric drive strength maximises switching speed.

Low Power.reasoning: Longer channels reduce leakage at idle; acceptable for low-frequency control logic.

Minimal Area.reasoning: Minimum-width transistors for highest density standard cell.

default.reasoning: 2:1 PMOS:NMOS ratio compensates for lower hole mobility; balanced rise/fall times.

sizing_notes.M_P: PMOS pull-up — sized ~2x NMOS width to equalise electron/hole mobility difference for matched t_pHL / t_pLH.
sizing_notes.M_N: NMOS pull-down — reference width; mobility advantage means it's sized smaller than PMOS.

kg_nodes.description: Input voltage at which output switches; ideally VDD/2 for symmetric noise margins.
Allowable input voltage deviation before output logic level becomes ambiguous.
